scope_limits: File hashes, code and receipts were checked independently; checkpoint tensors were not reloaded or rerun by this reviewer.
These are assistant-reviewed known target boxes with incomplete frame annotations, not human-approved complete ground truth.
Only target recall is supported. No full-image precision, AP, false-positive-rate or performance on unblurred faces/plates is established.

The five TSR taxonomy exclusions remain legitimate generic sign targets in the47-target detector evaluation. Their historical fine-class labels must not be represented as reviewed134-class ground truth.
There are three conservative training route groups and one validation route group; neither42 nor47 crops represent that many independent journeys.
Unchanged raw branches and unchanged observed post-NMS face/plate outputs do not establish privacy regression performance.
conclusion: The implementation and linked evidence support a small frozen-regression sign-output adaptation experiment. Results must be reported as exploratory known-target recall, split between native and projected views.
